turns.text: A $40 Ring doorbell? I had to check the fine print.
This is the Ring Battery Doorbell 2K. Amazon has it for $39.99 — that's 60% off the usual $99.99.
You get 2K video, 6x zoom, two-way talk, and a rechargeable battery, so no wiring. It works with Alexa and installs in about ten minutes.
The catch: cloud recordings need a Ring Protect plan, it's 2.4 GHz WiFi only, and some reviewers report dropouts. For a rental or first apartment, it's still a solid $40 starter doorbell.
Link's in the caption. Check the price before it jumps back up.
